newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand sells 20,000 tonnes rubber to Netherlands.
newsitem.headline: Thailand sells 20,000 tonnes rubber to Netherlands.

text.p: Thailand will sell 20,000 tonnes of sheet rubber to the Netherlands under a counter trade deal to buy fertilisers from the country, official and trade sources said on Friday.
The price of the RSS3 grade rubber was agreed at US$1,260 per tonne on FOB basis, the sources said.
Thailand will in turn purchase up to 500,000 tonnes of fertiliser from the Netherlands. The agreement is expected to be signed within 30 to 45 days from now, they said.
